sections.title: Financial Research
sections.primaryQuestion: What is mispriced, why, and what would change the view?

sections.title: AI Research
sections.primaryQuestion: What is changing in the AI stack, where is the bottleneck, and what is actually real?

rules: Financial research should center on exposure, valuation, risk budget, rerating path, and disconfirming evidence.
AI research should center on technical reality, workflow changes, bottlenecks, and stack implications even when there is no direct trade attached.
The same note should not appear in both sections in v1. Pick the dominant lens and tag the overlap instead.
If a note is too unfinished to be manually converted into JSON, it is not ready for publication.
